A circular cycle diagram showing the checks and balances in the Oyo Empire. At the top: 'Alaafin (King)'. Arrow points from Alaafin to 'Oyomesi' (Must be consulted on major state matters). Arrow points from 'Oyomesi' to 'Alaafin' (Can present an empty calabash to force his suicide). Arrow points from 'Oyomesi' to 'Ogboni' (Ogboni must approve the empty calabash). Arrow points from 'Ogboni' to 'Oyomesi' and 'Alaafin' (Acts as a mediator and religious check on both). Style: Clean flat textbook illustration, white background, bold text and arrows.

A pyramid diagram showing the bottom-up structure of the Igbo political system. Base level: 'Ezi / Ulo (The Nuclear Family)'. Second level: 'Umunna (The Extended Family / Lineage)'. Third level: 'Ogbe (The Village)'. Top level: 'Obodo (The Village Group / Town)'. Style: Clean flat textbook illustration, white background, clearly labelled blocks.
